message_source_quote: This is higher than the k=6 optimal reported by Raman et al. (2026) for the DM bench-items contrast, and the fit pass@10 exceeds the DM-based version (0.69).
writeup_source_quote: Raman et al. (2026) built the white-bear direction from WSB's directed_modulation bench items. We instead author our own contrast prompts: different concepts, carriers, no bench items.

differences.what: Message specifies the dose (k=6) at which Raman et al. (2026) found their optimum, a detail not stated in the write-up

rationale: Both documents name Raman et al. (2026) (white-bear steering / DM bench-items contrast) as the prior work whose dose/fit the new self-authored-prompt method is compared against, treating it as a baseline/contrast rather than claiming the new method reproduces or builds directly on it. Both frame the novelty identically: using self-written think/don't-think prompts instead of WSB directed_modulation bench items, yielding a different but comparable or better direction and performance.
